SDN.note: No link between civil register and ID stated.
Certificates issued are stated, but no digital register is named.
Card counts, not people enrolled, and no population share.
Pakistan's NADRA support is stated, but who operates or owns the system is not.
No register keyed on the ID stated.

facts.fact: Pakistan's interior minister Mohsin Naqvi said that with NADRA's support Sudan has issued nine million national identity cards (and 36 million citizenship cards) to date.

SDN.note: Birth and death certificates issued, but nothing on how local offices make the record.
